calls.head: The Blackhawks will send Cole and Vlasic at Scheifele
calls.body: At home, the Blackhawks keep sending Cole and Vlasic out against opponents’ first lines, far more often than chance would suggest. Jeff Blashill has been picking a defense pair for the other team’s top line. Tonight the Jets’ first line is Scheifele, Connor and Perfetti.
calls.call: The Blackhawks’ P3 (Cole and Vlasic) spends at least 73% of its 5-on-5 time against the Jets’ first line.

calls.head: Where the Jets have the edge: the power play
calls.body: The Jets are around the middle of the league for the power play, and the Blackhawks are the worst. It’s the widest gap between these two, though not a huge one.
calls.call: The Jets’ power play creates more per 60 than the Blackhawks’.

WPG.head: We leaned Winnipeg’s way (57%), but Chicago had other ideas.

surprises.head: Winnipeg brought the hits
surprises.body: Winnipeg’s hit score in the close stretches of the game was 162, against their usual 90 (100 is league average, adjusted for the arena’s scorer). A team strays this far about once every 45 games.

surprises.head: Chicago leaned on their bottom six
surprises.body: Chicago’s bottom-six forwards played 46% of the forwards’ 5-on-5 time, against their usual 42% and a league average of 42%. A team strays this far about once every 40 games.

story.head: Levshunov ends it in overtime
paras: Connor Bedard struck first for the Blackhawks on the power play midway through the first, with Tyler Bertuzzi picking up his 200th NHL assist on the assist. Frank Nazar stretched the lead to 2-0 late in the first. Neal Pionk got the Jets on the board 1:47 later. Ryan Donato made it 3-1 for the Blackhawks 14 seconds later. Kyle Connor cut it to 3-2 on the power play early in the second. Alex Iafallo tied it early in the third. Artyom Levshunov won it 1:37 into overtime. Pionk finished with a goal and two assists.

The chances were close to even, so this one could have gone either way. Spencer Knight made 31 saves for the Blackhawks, and Stuart Skinner stopped 24 of 28. The Hawks improved to 3-5-0, and the Jets fell to 4-1-2.

items.text: Patrick Kane set the NHL record for assists by a U.S.-born player, passing Phil Housley, with 896.
Kyle Connor has scored in four straight games.
Neal Pionk scored his first goal of the season, his first since Mar 21 (16 games played since).
One of the preview’s two calls held.
